# Make Video from GIF

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Creates a video from a GIF. It's pronounced GIF

## Syntax

~~~~text
videoFromGif(gif: <#Variable#>, loop: <#Number (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
videoFromGif(gif: newGIF, loop: 1)
~~~~
